sources.reason: The NOAA usnic_ims_snow_ice_1km ImageServer returns rendered symbology, not the documented 0-4 class grid, and is not used. The NSIDC G02156 archive serves the analysis itself over public HTTPS with no authentication: verified 2026-09-04 against ims2026246, which decodes to exactly the documented classes. It is a polar stereographic square whose corners fall off the projection disc, so it is reprojected through the separately published latitude and longitude grids. IMS covers the Northern Hemisphere only.
